findings.detail: final_observation checks outer deadline and records observed_at before outer.terminal.json is written. The subsequent direct outer record and emit lack remaining-deadline supervision and completion-time validation. The always witness accepts the saved pre-write observed_at. Receipt completion after the original t0+300 deadline can therefore still be accepted as RESOURCE_GATE_VERIFIED.
findings.required_change: Bound only the fixed pure resource observation/receipt/emit role by the original remaining outer budget, verify actual completion before the same outer deadline, and fail/UNKNOWN on timeout or late completion. Always observation completion must obey the same deadline. Do not move stop/restore/version collection outside aggregate64. Preserve full bounded receipt without routing a possible 16KiB receipt through an 8KiB management pipe. No fresh grace.

verified_static_paths: Exact three complete Git blobs, byte counts, SHA256 and mode; compare is three added administrative files only.
Workflow push/repository/ref guard, shared concurrency cancel-in-progress=false, read-only permissions, exact inline/file parity.
t0 captured before first administrative control action; primary/independent fallback use original inner270/outer300 timestamps.
Supervisor16, fallback16, collector32 share parent64/swap0 under project512; supervisor actual scope membership, oom readback and collector irreversible UID/GID/groups drop followed by actual gates.
Scope real command returncode contributes to outcome; scope state/MainPID alone is not treated as command success. No service-only Type/RemainAfterExit applied to scope.
Collector metadata is bounded up to32768 and emitted directly, not forwarded through the 8192 management receipt pipe.
Root resource receipt and unprivileged metadata remain separate. Old final oom0/absent/late failures remain whole-job failure/UNKNOWN; metadata success alone is not resource success.
No Subject/token/network probe/install/upgrade; original six Subject stages explicitly NOT_RUN; no old-run version backfill.

environment_boundary.scope_and_collector: Actual explicit PATH/LC/PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE environment paths reviewed; scope launch is not an external --pipe metadata forwarder.
environment_boundary.fallback: Transient service uses manager default execution environment; the launching systemd-run client's clean environment is not proof that the service environment is identical. No job-token inheritance or leak was demonstrated. Do not claim service environment was fully cleared merely because values were not printed.
